fp4_scalar_attention_decode.note: FP4 cache attention loader used scalar software e2m1 decode from its introduction; not introduced by the recent prefill score-fusion changes.

glm_flash_auto_prefill_budget.note: Default cancellable prefill resolves supported engines to a 256-token budget; TP2 template has no explicit idle override, unlike TP4. Configuration tuning issue, not an allocation or swapping issue.

mimo_fp8_dispatch_gap.note: The optimized per-weight FP8 GEMM was wired into the ordinary large-row dispatcher, but the explicit-grid dispatcher used by MiMo retained the old 16-row tile kernel. This is a missed optimization, not a slowdown introduced by the recent score-fusion fixes.
